title: Introducing the new iPhone Duo
text:
iPhone Duo is a foldable iPhone with the largest iPhone display ever and reimagined iOS experiences for unprecedented versatility, including side-by-side apps for multitasking, hands-free FaceTime calls, and flexible viewing. It features an inner display that’s 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max, a titanium frame, a 48MP Dual Fusion camera, all-new ways to shoot, the A20 Pro chip, a dual-battery system for all-day power, and Siri AI, your more personal, more powerful AI assistant. 

Learn more about iPhone Duo: https://apple.co/4xGXCBP

title: Introducing the new iPhone 18 Pro
text:
iPhone 18 Pro is Apple’s most powerful iPhone yet. It features the A20 Pro chip, which has exceptional AI capabilities and is cooled by a next-generation vapor chamber. It delivers the longest battery life ever in an iPhone — 6 more hours of video playback on iPhone 18 Pro Max compared with iPhone 17 Pro Max. A Pro camera system with variable aperture, greater depth of field, and better-quality low-light photos. And Siri AI, your more personal, more powerful AI assistant.

Learn more about iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max: https://apple.co/4r3O3KV

title: Apple Event September 9 2026: Introducing iPhone Duo and more
text:
Watch the special Apple Event to learn about iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5. 

iPhone Duo is a foldable iPhone with the largest iPhone display ever and reimagined iOS experience for ultimate versatility.

iPhone 18 Pro, the ultimate upgrade. Purpose-built for unprecedented performance, exceptional AI capabilities, a 48MP Fusion Main camera with new variable aperture, and the longest battery life ever.

Apple Watch Series 12 has the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable. 

Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the longest battery life of any Apple Watch. Now with up to 45 hours of Max Extended Workout tracking.

AirPods 5 feature the best Active Noise Cancellation in an open-ear design, and a redesigned acoustic architecture for richer, more detailed sound.
